claims.text: The Pulumi for Terraform Users guide teaches how to reference existing Terraform state files from Pulumi, use any Terraform provider in Pulumi programs, import and use Terraform modules directly, convert HCL to Pulumi, and orchestrate Terraform and Pulumi deployments together.

The `terraform.state.S3Reference` class exists in the `@pulumi/terraform` package (also accessed as `pulumi.terraform.state.S3Reference`) and takes `bucket` and `key` arguments, with a `getOutput` method.
`pulumi.terraform.state.S3Reference` is exported from the `@pulumi/pulumi/automation` import.
`new pulumi.StackReference("core-infra")` with `getOutput("vpcId")` retrieves stack outputs.
`pulumi import` can bring Terraform-managed resources under Pulumi management.
The `pulumi import` command syntax `pulumi import aws:ec2/vpc:Vpc main-vpc vpc-12345` (type token, name, ID) is valid.
Pulumi policies can enforce infrastructure policy across both Terraform and Pulumi resources.
`@pulumi/policy` exports `PolicyPack` and `validateResourceOfType`, with `enforcementLevel: "mandatory"` and `validateResource` policy fields.
Automation API `LocalWorkspace.createOrSelectStack` accepts stackName, projectName and program; `stack.setConfig` and `stack.up({onOutput})` exist.
`aws.ecs.Cluster` accepts `configuration.executeCommandConfiguration` with `kmsKeyId` and `logging: "DEFAULT"`.
`aws.s3.Bucket` has an `acl` property with values "public-read" and "public-read-write".
Component resources can integrate with Terraform behind the scenes, leaving multi-tool complexity to platform teams.
Pages exist at /docs/intro/concepts/, /docs/using-pulumi/adopting-pulumi/, /docs/intro/vs/terraform/, /docs/iac/concepts/automation-api/, /docs/insights/policy/.
A page exists at /docs/iac/guides/building-extending/.
The pulumi/examples repository contains hundreds of real-world examples.
Pulumi Community page offers a community Slack and forum.
Pulumi case studies exist for Snowflake (multi-cloud, using Pulumi with existing tools), Mercedes-Benz (platform engineering), and Lemonade (rapid development with Pulumi and Terraform).
Pulumi YouTube channel is at youtube.com/pulumitv.
Pulumi Support at support.pulumi.com provides professional support for Pulumi Cloud customers.
CONTRIBUTING.md exists on master branch of pulumi/pulumi and pulumi/examples.
Pulumi has events page at /events/ and user groups at /community/.
